🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 2, 2026

Moon, in Gemini, holds a trine to the North Node, on the karmic axis in Aquarius. The same air temperament, twice over: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon in Gemini makes room for you, and then waits. Cardinal fire: the opening move is the cheap one. Mars has been out of Cancer for four weeks now.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. From Scorpio, Mercury quotes your worth back at you. Fixed earth: the grip costs more than the thing. Three weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon is in your sign, and distance stops being available. Mutable air: both answers turn out to be one answer. Mercury has not been in Virgo for four weeks.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you from Gemini, borrowed ground, taken as it comes. Mercury trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Water moves first here, and first is enough. What pressed two weeks ago has cleared.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you, fallen in Libra. Moon in Gemini opens a gap you have to step into. Fixed fire keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. Since Sun crossed out of Virgo, the question has changed.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. From Gemini, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Earth bends, and each bend is invoiced. A week ago Mercury was still held by Jupiter; that is finished.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Moon in Gemini sides with you before you have argued. Cardinal air: beginning costs almost nothing. Four weeks ago Venus was still in Libra: the ground has moved.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. Mercury crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Fixed water: the holding and the held stop differing. The sextile of a week ago is off it now.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From Gemini, Moon returns your estimate with corrections. Fire that changes shape, charged for each shape. Mercury let go of it a week ago.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Libra, Sun cuts across the appetite. Earth opens the file, and the file has a price. The hold Jupiter had a week ago is not there any more.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Moon trines you from Gemini, and the ease asks its own attention. Fixed air holds, and holding asks nothing back. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon squares you from Gemini, and something has to give way. Mutable water: every option kept is an option paid for. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.
